what: Thermo Fisher Scientific supplies laboratories: scientific instruments, chemicals and consumables, diagnostic tests, and contract services that help drug companies develop and manufacture medicines.
customers: Pharma and biotech companies, hospitals and diagnostic labs, universities and governments.
money: lab supplies, drug development and manufacturing services
moat: Unmatched breadth and scale, a large share of recurring consumables and services, and a strong record of acquisitions.
risks: Swings in biotech funding and pharma spending
